label: Shell scripts with ShellCheck
description: Lints shell scripts (*.sh, *.bash, *.dash, *.ksh, and extensionless files whose first line is a shell shebang) with ShellCheck and the project's .shellcheckrc. Every issue is a located finding; nothing is rewritten. Comes in by evidence: a shell script with one of those extensions anywhere in the project; once active, shebang-only scripts are checked too.
